2.50.32
Matrix.RowGroupings
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Matrix.RowGroupings element specifies the collection of row groupings for a Matrix. This
element MUST be specified. The Matrix.MatrixRows element is of type RowGroupings.
Following is the parent element of the Matrix.MatrixRowGroupings element.
Parent elements
 Matrix
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Matrix.MatrixRowGroupings element.
 <xsd:element name="RowGroupings" type="RowGroupingsType" />
